# Second Innings

> Second Innings is a small, Hyderabad-only nonprofit that collects unused sports
> equipment (cricket, football, badminton, basketball, volleyball), gets it
> refurbished through local partner sports stores, and gives it free to government
> schools, academies and community coaches in Hyderabad, India. It does not accept
> or ask for money — Second Innings is not yet a registered organisation, so it
> cannot issue tax-deductible receipts, and it asks for equipment, time and
> introductions instead.

## Key facts

- Operates in Hyderabad, India only — no other city, no shipping.
- Accepts: cricket, football, badminton, basketball, volleyball equipment.
- Does not accept: trophies, medals, memorabilia, or adult-only gear with no youth
  equivalent.
- Registration status: not yet a registered organisation (as of August 2026). Does
  not solicit or accept financial donations for this reason. Equipment, storage
  space, a vehicle, or volunteering time are what it asks for instead.
- Contact: second.innings456@gmail.com — Instagram: @projectsecondinnings
- Team: six volunteers covering direction, operations, finance & tech, social
  media & outreach, event planning, and creative design — no paid staff.

## Pages

- [Home](https://secondinningsngowesbite.vercel.app/): Overview of the mission —
  collect, refurbish, redistribute.
- [What We Do](https://secondinningsngowesbite.vercel.app/what-we-do.html): The
  four-step process (collected, assessed, refurbished, playing again), and
  frequently asked questions including the tax-receipt policy.
- [Donate Your Gear](https://secondinningsngowesbite.vercel.app/donate-gear.html):
  What equipment is accepted, condition guidelines, and the donation form
  (drop-off, pickup, or a collection drive).
- [Request Equipment](https://secondinningsngowesbite.vercel.app/request-equipment.html):
  For government schools, academies, coaches and community programmes to apply
  for free equipment — no cost, no catch.
- [Get Involved](https://secondinningsngowesbite.vercel.app/get-involved.html):
  Ways to help without giving money — volunteering, running a collection drive,
  partnering as a repair store, offering storage or transport, or a corporate CSR
  project.
- [Corporate & CSR](https://secondinningsngowesbite.vercel.app/corporate.html):
  A standalone page for companies — engagement options (office drives, sponsoring
  a batch of kits, a volunteering day), and an honest note that no tax receipt can
  be issued yet given the registration status.
- [FAQ](https://secondinningsngowesbite.vercel.app/faq.html): All frequently
  asked questions in one place — what's accepted, how requests are matched,
  registration and tax-receipt status, timelines, and how to reach the team.
- [Our Impact](https://secondinningsngowesbite.vercel.app/impact.html): How
  equipment counts are measured and what is not claimed; transparency on
  registration status.
- [Partner Stores](https://secondinningsngowesbite.vercel.app/partners.html):
  Explains how refurbishment through local sports stores works. Stores are not
  yet publicly named on the site; includes a pitch for store owners to join.
- [Stories](https://secondinningsngowesbite.vercel.app/stories.html): A running
  log of real collection drives and handovers. Honestly empty at launch — no
  placeholder stories — updated as real ones happen, with @projectsecondinnings
  on Instagram as the interim source.
- [About](https://secondinningsngowesbite.vercel.app/about.html): Mission,
  beliefs, and where the organisation operates.
- [Our Team](https://secondinningsngowesbite.vercel.app/team.html): The six
  people who run Second Innings and what each of them does.
- [Contact](https://secondinningsngowesbite.vercel.app/contact.html): Direct
  contact details and a general enquiry form.
- [Privacy](https://secondinningsngowesbite.vercel.app/privacy.html): What
  personal information is collected through the site's forms and why.
